CRYSTAL CLEAR AIR: the air perfectly clear to the farthest ridge, tiny bright motes sparkling gently in the light, still and luminous
SPARKLING STILLNESS: crystal air stretching crisp and open to the horizon, a soft glitter of tiny motes catching the light, calm and bright
BRIGHT MOTE DANCE: the air beautifully clear, little sparkling motes drifting lazily through the light, the far distance sharp and inviting
CLEAR TO THE HORIZON: perfectly transparent air carrying a gentle shimmer of tiny bright specks, the far layers crisp and luminous
OPEN SPARKLING AIR: the air wide and crystal clear, soft bright motes turning slowly in the light, the whole vista vivid and still
SOFT GOLDEN HAZE: a warm golden haze lying gently over the valley, thickening with distance until the far ridges fade to soft pale gold
WARM DISTANT HAZE: a tender amber haze softening the middle layers, the farthest peaks dissolving into a gentle glowing paleness
GOLDEN DEPTH HAZE: warm haze pooling between the far hills, each receding layer a little softer and more golden than the last
AMBER VEIL OF DISTANCE: a soft warm amber haze thickening toward the horizon, the nearest air clear and the far edges fading to pale honey
FALLS MIST RISING: a soft white mist rising gently from the base of the falls, wreathing the lower rocks and thinning to clear bright air above
LOW VALLEY MIST: a low soft mist lying quietly along the valley floor, pale and gentle, thinning at the edges into open bright air
WREATHING BASE MIST: thin pale mist curling softly around the landmark's base, rising in soft slow wisps before thinning to clear air above
THINNING MORNING MIST: soft mist clinging close to the ground and thinning gradually upward into perfectly clear and open air
GENTLE MIST VEIL: a soft translucent mist drifting slowly at the landmark's feet, pale and quiet, dissolving into brightness as it rises
DANDELION DRIFT: hundreds of dandelion seeds drifting slowly through the air, each one catching the light like a tiny soft spark, the distance clear
BLOSSOM PETAL FALL: pale pink petals floating down gently through the air, tumbling softly end over end, drifting wide across the open vista
GLOWING SPORE DRIFT: soft luminous spores drifting through the air like slow warm snow, each one glowing faintly as it turns in the light
PETAL SHOWER: a gentle shower of small bright petals floating slowly downward, spinning and drifting wide, filling the air with soft colour
SEED AND PETAL AIR: a lovely mix of floating petals and drifting feathery seeds moving slowly together through the calm open air
HIGH CLOUD WISPS: soft feathered wisps of cloud passing slowly at the landmark's height, pale and gentle, trailing their fine edges as they go
FEATHERED WISPS: thin wispy clouds drifting softly past, feather-edged and slow, trailing delicate threads of pale white across the open air
SLOW PASSING WISPS: gentle cloud wisps moving slowly through the air at the landmark's level, soft and unhurried, fading at their trailing edges
HEAT SHIMMER: a gentle warm shimmer rising from the sunlit ground, the far edges of the vista wavering softly in the sweet warmth
WARM GROUND SHIMMER: a soft heat shimmer drifting above the sunlit earth, the distant layers shivering gently at their edges in the warm air
FROST SPARKLE AIR: crisp cold air carrying a fine glitter of frost drifting slowly, the whole vista still and brilliantly clear
